product_brief: A comprehensive suite of FIPS Approved algorithms implemented in pure Java for use by US Federal agencies and other markets.
pqc_support: Partial — HSS and LMS signature schemes (RFC 8708) are listed as non-approved algorithms not allowed in approved mode.
pqc_capability_description: The module lists HSS (RFC 8708) and LMS (RFC 8708) signature schemes in Table 6 as "Non-Approved Algorithms Not Allowed in the Approved Mode of Operation." This indicates the software contains implementations of these stateful hash-based signature algorithms, but they are explicitly excluded from the FIPS 140-3 approved mode of operation. No other PQC algorithms (e.g., ML-KEM, ML-DSA) are mentioned.
crypto_primitives: AES (ECB, CBC, CFB, CTR, GCM, CCM, CMAC, KW, KWP, FF1), SHA-1, SHA-2 (224, 256, 384, 512, 512/224, 512/256), SHA-3 (224, 256, 384, 512), SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256, cSHAKE-128, cSHAKE-256, KMAC-128, KMAC-256, TupleHash-128, TupleHash-256, ParallelHash-128, ParallelHash-256, DSA, ECDSA, RSA, HMAC, PBKDF, KDF (SP800-108, SP800-135, SP800-56C), KAS (ECC, FFC, IFC), KTS-IFC, DRBG (Counter, Hash, HMAC).
key_management_model: Software-based key generation and management within a Java Archive (JAR) file; supports approved and non-approved modes.
primary_platforms: Android 16, VMware Photon OS 4.0/5.0, Java SE Runtime Environment v8/v11/v17/v21, Dell PowerEdge R650, Google Pixel 9 Pro XL, Samsung Galaxy S24
signature_schemes: DSA, ECDSA, RSA (PSS and PKCS1.5), HSS (non-approved), LMS (non-approved)
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP tested (Certificates A4399, A8025), FIPS 140-3 Validation (Acumen Security Lab)
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Uses DRBG (Counter, Hash, HMAC) compliant with SP 800-90A; supports external RNG.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Tested on Android devices (Google Pixel 9 Pro XL, Samsung Galaxy S24).
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Vendor is Higher Ground LLC; module is a single JAR file (bc-fips-2.0.0.jar).
